response.justification: While highly experienced in software engineering, the candidate's background is heavily focused on full-stack web and distributed technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, Dlang) rather than C++. His C++ experience is limited to a brief 6-month stint nearly a decade ago, and he lacks the necessary domain expertise in industrial automation, IoT protocols (MQTT), and industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) required for this role.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (18+ years) with strong architectural and full-stack design skills.
Proven ability to build high-performance, distributed microservices handling millions of requests per second.
Possesses the advantageous skills in Node.js, React, and agile methodologies mentioned in the job description.
concerns: C++ experience is severely limited and outdated, lacking the depth in STL and modern C++ required for a senior role.
No demonstrated background in industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL).
Missing relevant experience with IoT and industrial automation protocols such as MQTT, Modbus, or OPC UA.
